gloss: no more waiting; now or never; allowing no delay

definitions.gloss: no more waiting; allowing no delay; now or never
definitions.explanation: Said of a situation that cannot be postponed any longer and demands action now. From sumo and board games, where {待|ま}った is a call asking the opponent to wait or to take back a move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{待|ま}ったなしだ。
⟦{温暖化|おんだんか}{対策|たいさく}→温暖化対策：25184_ondankataisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{待|ま}ったなし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Measures against global warming are now urgent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{待|ま}ったなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: Three days to the deadline: there's no more time, and I just have to finish it.

notes:
In sumo, a wrestler who is not ready at the start may call ⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ ("wait!"); in shogi and go, the word asks to take back a move. {待|ま}ったなし originally meant a bout or game in which that was not allowed, and now means any matter that allows no further delay. Common in news and politics.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{待|ま}ったなしだ: … cannot wait
- {待|ま}ったなし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ / ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧: an urgent situation / issue
- {待|ま}ったなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: without delay, with no second chances

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{急務|きゅうむ}→急務：21059_kyuumu⟧: urgent task — a formal noun; {待|ま}ったなし is more vivid and conversational
